segments.interpretation: The executable claim is the negative descriptive conditional-minus-whole-scope mean difference. Replenishing supply and latent demand remain proposed mechanisms, not measured outcomes or identified causal effects. No empirical result, profitability finding, or scientific acceptance is asserted.
segments.text: Hypothesis: unusually intense aggressive buying that produces an intrabar rally but almost no retained gain in ETHUSDT reflects replenishing passive sell supply rather than latent bullish demand. Contrary to the standard intuition that high taker-buy participation and high turnover predict continuation, I hypothesize a lower subsequent one-hour ETH return after this failed buying impulse than across the whole eligible ETH scope. This is an original, untested development hypothesis, not evidence of profitability or a causal conclusion.

segments.interpretation: The universe is ETHUSDT only, with the exact inclusive start, exclusive end, and 900-second grid. Scope is true at every declared decision coordinate, not just at existing market rows. Under the explicitly supplied required-inputs/1 implementation selected by reference-computation/4, all actual feature dependencies must remain inside this interval; earlier dependencies are not fetched from December. Missing signal or window dependencies make the condition unknown without removing an otherwise observed outcome from the whole-scope population. Development exposure and unknown training exposure remain qualifications.
segments.text: Instrument and dates: Binance spot ETHUSDT only; BTCUSDT is not used. Decision times t are every UTC 900-second grid point in [2023-01-01T00:00:00Z, 2023-04-01T00:00:00Z). All input observations must also lie within that interval; no December warmup or other historical inputs are permitted. All historical information is development exposure, and training exposure is unknown.

segments.interpretation: The outer one-bar lag evaluates both the validity predicate and the signal predicate at s=t-900. Historical reads retain the original decision cutoff, including the exclusive-end cap; they do not acquire a historical-anchor cutoff. segments.text: Timing: raw observations are keyed by exclusive bar end s. Their availability is assumed to be s+900 seconds, not established historical publication truth. At decision t use the signal bar ending s=t-900; never use the bar ending t. Respect any additional recorded unavailability. Conditions are evaluated with as_of=t and cutoff min(t, 2023-04-01T00:00:00Z minus one second).

segments.interpretation: At the signal anchor, P at /candidate/condition_ast/expression/arg/left/right is exactly the five inclusive comparisons implementing the four stated criteria, with the retained-gain interval split into its two endpoints. Each median is lag(trailing_median(Q,96),1), giving exactly s-900 through s-86400 and the exact average of the two central sorted observations. The complete-validity composition is at /candidate/condition_ast/expression/arg. Its identical V copies are at /candidate/condition_ast/expression/arg/left/left and /candidate/condition_ast/expression/arg/right/left/arg. In V, the left branch checks O_s>0, Q_s>0, and the complete median M_s>0; the right-left branch checks B_s>=0 and B_s<=Q_s; the right-right self-equalities require observed H_s and C_s. O_s, Q_s, B_s and all 96 baseline observations must likewise be present to make V true. Finite execution admission and the supplied raw-feature validity/null transformations supply finite scalar inputs; self-equality is not a nonfinite-input detector. Thus V is true only when all required condition inputs are complete, available and valid. G=(V AND P) OR ((NOT V) AND unknown) yields P only for V=true and unknown otherwise, including when another signal comparison is false. No threshold, median, eligibility rule or fitting choice is changed. This mapping is offered for independent review, not as evidence that such review has occurred.
segments.text: Exact condition: let O_s, H_s, C_s, Q_s, and B_s be ETH open, high, close, quote volume, and taker quote volume for the signal bar. Let M_s be the ordinary median of quote volumes at the preceding 96 exact grid ends s-900k, k=1,...,96; for 96 observations use the arithmetic average of the two central sorted values. Require all 96 observations, without skipping or substitution. The condition is true exactly when B_s/Q_s >= 0.65, Q_s >= 2*M_s, H_s/O_s-1 >= 0.003, and 0 <= C_s/O_s-1 <= 0.0005. Require finite values, O_s>0, Q_s>0, M_s>0, and 0<=B_s<=Q_s. No additional screening or tuning is proposed. A 65% buy share represents materially one-sided aggressive flow; twice the preceding day's median turnover distinguishes a participation burst from ordinary noise; a 30-basis-point upward excursion with only zero to five basis points retained isolates failed upward progress. The 96-bar baseline spans one day without requiring an additional regime model. These are mechanism-motivated exploratory choices, not fitted thresholds.

segments.interpretation: At h=5 the anchor is a=t+4500. lag(close,1) reads C at a-900=t+3600, and lag(open,4) reads O at a-3600=t+900. Their ratio is dimensionless; multiplication by the basis-point conversion literal gives log basis points. The supplied raw price definitions require positive decimals and transform invalid keyed bars to null; execution admission requires finite inputs. Consequently both observed raw prices are finite and positive, rather than merely accepting a positive ratio of two invalid negative prices. Missing required rows, values, availability or permitted keys leave Y missing. The fixed-delay dependency check is explicit: the close is available at a and the open at a-2700. For elapsed in-universe anchors, a later inherited as_of cutoff cannot newly admit either fixed-delay input compared with the original anchor cutoff; the exclusive-end cap is retained. No unused decision or outcome-anchor container is required by required-inputs/1. This is a dependency mapping, not a claim of completed snapshot replay or historical availability verification. Natural logarithm uses bounded-math/1.0 outward enclosures, not a simple-return replacement or midpoint decision. The future open remains solely an outcome input.
segments.text: Outcome: choose positive integer h=5, so the outcome evaluation anchor is a=t+4500 seconds. Define Y_t=10000*ln(C_{t+3600}/O_{t+900}), using ETH bar-end keys. The denominator is the opening price of the bar spanning t to t+900; the numerator is the close of the bar ending t+3600. Thus Y describes the market's one-hour price change starting at decision t, expressed in log basis points. It is not a return from the stale signal close. At anchor a, the final close has its assumed 900-second publication delay satisfied. Both prices must be finite and positive, available by cutoff min(a, 2023-04-01T00:00:00Z minus one second), and have keys within the permitted interval. Near-end outcomes lacking these requirements remain missing; do not obtain April data or shorten the horizon. The future opening price is an outcome measurement, not information available to the condition or an assumed executable fill. Raw ETH prices have units USDT/ETH; only their ratios and Y are dimensionless.

segments.interpretation: The estimator is mean(Y|C=true,S=true,Y observed) minus mean(Y|S=true,Y observed), with equal decision-row weights, no nuisance fitting and a negative direction. The scope baseline includes condition-true, condition-false and condition-unknown rows. It is neither a complement comparison nor a claim that the conditional mean is below zero. Overlapping outcomes are retained; independence is not asserted.
segments.text: Comparison and weighting: the target descriptive contrast is the equal-decision-row mean Y among condition-true rows minus the equal-decision-row mean Y across the entire ETH decision grid with observed Y, including condition-false and condition-unknown rows. This intentionally uses the whole-scope benchmark, not a matched control or false-only group. The hypothesized contrast is negative. It need not imply that the conditional mean itself is negative. Overlapping hourly outcomes remain included with equal weight; they are not independent observations.

All declared scope-true coordinates receive condition evaluation, even without decision containers. Only actual raw feature reads require rows, and every median argument at every exact position is required. Unknown conditions remain in the observed whole-scope denominator. Diagnostics map boundary censoring to the contract's boundary category; absent rows to absent required rows; unavailable data to unavailable-data events; missing warmup to missing-warmup and, where applicable, pre-universe-dependency events; condition unknown to the evaluated unknown-condition category. Original invalid values map to traced domain/typed-null and missing-value/feature observations with their source qualifications, together with failed or unknown complete-validity checks, not to an invented undifferentiated cause. The exact recognized guard path is /candidate/condition_ast/expression/arg beneath the outer lag; V paths are /candidate/condition_ast/expression/arg/left/left and /candidate/condition_ast/expression/arg/right/left/arg. V=false records failure of at least one stated validity check; V=unknown records unresolved required completeness/availability/validity, with overlapping actual-read events distinguishing available causes. Source-invalid-to-null observations retain their raw transformation qualification; a literal null is not a missing market feature, and nonfinite execution inputs fail row admission. Categories overlap and count each row once per category. No unused coordinate is counted as missing market data. Missing Y enters neither mean; an empty conditional group is undefined/INFORMATION_GAP, not zero. Numerical or diagnostic resource exhaustion must be reported explicitly, with partial diagnostic processed/unprocessed counts and RESOURCE_STOP rather than silent completeness; numerical incompleteness yields no effect. segments.text: Missingness: if any required condition input or baseline observation is absent, null, unavailable, invalid under the stated checks, or outside the interval, label the condition unknown rather than false; use complete-condition evaluation rather than inferring false from a partial conjunction. Never forward-fill. Condition-unknown rows stay in scope and enter the whole-scope outcome mean when Y is observed, but never enter the conditional mean. Missing Y is excluded from either mean, with separate counts retained for boundary censoring, absent rows, invalid values, unavailable data, missing warmup, and condition unknown. An empty conditional group leaves the contrast undefined. These rules make the descriptive estimand an observed-outcome contrast, with selection limitations rather than an implied result for missing outcomes.
